task.instruction: Search an Xbox Wireless controller with green color and rated above 4 stars.

final_answer:
I found a match on Amazon: the **Xbox Wireless Controller – Velocity Green (Series X|S, One, and Windows Devices)** — Renewed.

- **Rating:** 4.4 out of 5 stars (177 ratings) — comfortably above your 4-star threshold
- **Color:** Velocity Green
- **Price:** MYR 227.10
- **Seller:** MayflowerMobile, listed as Refurbished – Excellent, returnable until Jan 31, 2027
- **Link:** https://www.amazon.com/Xbox-Wireless-Controller-Velocity-Windows-Devices/dp/B0C75RMKCZ

I applied Amazon's 4-stars-and-up filter to the search for "xbox wireless controller green," and this was the top result. A couple of alternatives also met your criteria if you'd like options: the **XBOX Wireless Gaming Controller in Electric Volt** (4.6 stars, 19,657 ratings) and the **Retro Fighters Hunter Wireless Controller in Green** (4.5 stars, 338 ratings, MYR 241.88). Note that the Velocity Green listing is a renewed/refurbished unit — if you want a brand-new one, the Electric Volt or a new-condition Velocity Green offer would be the way to go.

judge.rationale: Final page shows “Xbox Wireless Controller – Velocity Green” with a 4.4/5 rating, satisfying green color and above 4 stars.
